title: Board metadata
description: Top-level config for a single arcade board. Lives at boards/<id>/board.json. Identifies the drawing, lists the source-image sheets, and declares the off-page-connector convention so the graph + tracer pipelines can interpret cross-sheet linkage.

id.description: Board id, also the directory name under boards/. Must match the folder name.

drawing_number.description: Manufacturer's drawing number, e.g. '77-0019' for Exidy 440 logic board

shared_titles.description: Other arcade titles that share this same logic PCB (e.g. Crossbow/Cheyenne/Combat all share Exidy 77-0019).

preferred_scan_source.description: Where the highest-resolution scans live, with a reason. Multiple manuals often contain the same drawing at different resolutions; the preferred source is documented here.

source.description: Structured declaration of the source-image kind. Tools (cartographer, identifier) branch on this so an LLM with limited reasoning can call e.g. crop-chip without deciding whether to use --pdf — the harness picks. `vector_pdf` means the canonical PDF carries crisp vector lines and chip-text crops should re-render from PDF on demand at a higher DPI; `raster_scan` means the scan IS the source of truth and high-DPI PDF rendering would just upscale noise.

pdf_path.description: Path (relative to the board folder) of the source PDF. Required when kind is vector_pdf.

default_render_dpi.description: DPI at which crop-chip / tile re-render the PDF on demand (vector_pdf only). Default 600.

scan_dpi.description: DPI of the canonical scans in sheets[].scan_path. Used to compute the bbox-rescale factor when rendering the PDF at a different DPI.

scan_path.description: Path to the cleaned PNG, relative to the board folder. e.g. ../../exidy/scans/pages/logic_sheet1_video_ram_mpx.png

scan_pixel_size.description: [width, height] of the scan in pixels

off_page_convention.description: How the schematic represents nets that cross sheets.

phase1_target.description: First milestone scope for this board — useful as a cap on early transcription work.

external_oracles.description: External sources of truth (e.g. MAME driver) used to cross-check inferred memory maps and net assignments.
